Play in 7 acts on the marriage of Śāhaji and Līlāvatī. To be enacted at that Mahāmakam festival of God Kumbheśvara at Kumbakonam. See: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
